rows: Pulls the numbers, fills in the template and drafts the commentary. The account manager sends it.

Tracks hours against each retainer and drafts invoices for finance to approve.

images.name: monday
images.title: A Monday at a *marketing agency*
rows: Checks every client ad account. One campaign has spent 80% of its monthly budget by the 9th.
Builds four monthly reports with draft commentary for the account managers to edit.
Sends a new client the third reminder for Meta partner access, with the steps attached.
A client replies to a report asking why leads dropped. It goes to the account manager with the numbers.
Schedules a week of approved posts for three clients and checks Friday's all published.
Combines one client's feedback from five emails into a single list on the design task.
One client has used 90% of the month's retainer hours. It tells the account director.

steps: Check each one for confidentiality terms and any clause about AI tools.
Map a month of account work
